data.description: Na mistrzostwach Europy w Birmingham świetnie zaprezentowały się nasze biegaczki, panie zdobyły też medal w skoku wzwyż. Panowie mogą się od nich uczyć.
data.translatedTitle: European Athletics Championships. Poland strong with women
data.translatedDescription: Our runners performed great at the European Championships in Birmingham, and the ladies also won a medal in the high jump. Men can learn from them.

data.title: Trzęsienie ziemi na szczytach OpenAI. Fala odejść przed giełdowym debiutem
data.description: Wojna o ludzi, którzy mają stworzyć kolejną generację sztucznej inteligencji, wchodzi w nową fazę. Z największych firm AI odchodzą doświadczeni menedżerowie i naukowcy, a konkurenci podbierają sobie kluczowych pracowników. Kiedy OpenAI szykuje się do potencjalnego giełdowego debiutu, doświadczyło poważnego wstrząsu.
data.translatedTitle: Earthquake at the OpenAI peaks. A wave of departures before the stock exchange debut
data.translatedDescription: The war for people who will create the next generation of artificial intelligence is entering a new phase. Experienced managers and scientists are leaving the largest AI companies, and competitors are poaching key employees. As OpenAI prepares for a potential stock market debut, it has experienced a major shock.

data.title: Izraelski minister chce „celowanych zabójstw” w Gazie. „30–40 osób każdej nocy”
data.description: Minister bezpieczeństwa narodowego Izraela Itamar Ben Gwir opowiedział się za tym, by w Strefie Gazy „prowadzić celowane zabójstwa, eliminując każdej nocy od 30 do 40 osób”. Jak podała agencja AP w niedzielę, słowa padły podczas wywiadu w podkaście byłego zakładnika Hamasu Roma Brasławskiego.
data.translatedTitle: Israeli minister wants 'targeted killings' in Gaza. "30-40 people every night"
data.translatedDescription: Israel's Minister of National Security, Itamar Ben Gwir, advocated "conducting targeted killings in the Gaza Strip, eliminating 30 to 40 people every night." As reported by the AP agency on Sunday, the words were spoken during a podcast interview with former Hamas hostage Roma Braslavski.

data.title: Węgierska policja zatrzymała kierowcę polskiego autokaru. MSZ zabiera głos po tragedii
data.description: Wojciech Zajączkowski – wiceszef Ministerstwa Spraw Zagranicznych – przekazał, że policja przesłuchała dwóch kierowców autokaru, który uległ wypadkowi na Węgrzech. Jeden został zwolniony, drugiego zatrzymano. Specjalnym samolotem na Węgry poleciał także zespół sześciu medyków, którzy ocenią stan zdrowia rannych.
data.translatedTitle: The Hungarian police detained the driver of the Polish bus. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs speaks out after the tragedy
data.translatedDescription: Wojciech Zajączkowski - deputy head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs - said that the police had questioned two drivers of the bus that had an accident in Hungary. One was released, the other was detained. A team of six medics also flew to Hungary on a special plane to assess the health condition of the injured.

data.title: Přehrada na Vysočině zachraňuje Brno, v posledních letech dodává stále více vody
data.description: Už více než sto let přivádí do Brna pitnou vodu dvojice vodovodů z prameniště u Březové nad Svitavou na Pardubicku. Jenže poslední roky kvůli suchu a klesající hladině v tamních vrtech berou Brněnské vodárny a kanalizace čím dál více vody z druhého zdroje pro čtyřsettisícové město, a to z přehrady Vír na pomezí Jihomoravského kraje a Vysočiny.
data.translatedTitle: The dam in Vysočina saves Brno, in recent years it has been supplying more and more water
data.translatedDescription: For more than a hundred years, a pair of aqueducts has been bringing drinking water to Brno from the spring at Březová nad Svitavou in Pardubice. But in recent years, due to the drought and the falling water level in the wells there, the Brno waterworks and sewers have been taking more and more water from the second source for the city of 400,000 people, namely from the Vír dam on the border of the South Moravian Region and Vysočina.

data.title: Ministři budou po návratu z dovolené jednat o opatřeních proti suchu
data.description: Na prvním jednání po dvoutýdenní letní dovolené se v pondělí schází vláda Andreje Babiše. Zabývat se podle premiéra a předsedy ANO bude opatřeními proti extrémnímu suchu a pro zadržování vody v krajině. Má to řešit Národní koalice proti suchu.
data.translatedTitle: Ministers will discuss drought measures after returning from vacation
data.translatedDescription: The government of Andrej Babiš meets on Monday for the first meeting after the two-week summer vacation. According to the prime minister and the chairman of ANO, measures against extreme drought and water retention in the countryside will be dealt with. The National Coalition Against Drought is to deal with it.

data.title: Když mi nedáš, hodím ti granát do zákopu. Zdravotnice líčí poměry v ruské armádě
data.description: Trestankyně, které ruská armáda naverbovala ve věznicích jako zdravotnice, čelí po příjezdu na frontu sexuálnímu násilí, výhrůžkám a nátlaku. Nová svědectví bývalých vězeňkyň ukazují, že velitelé jejich stížnosti ignorují a ženy po zranění či porodu nutí dál sloužit.
data.translatedTitle: If you don't, I'll throw a grenade into your trench. A nurse describes conditions in the Russian army
data.translatedDescription: Convicts recruited by the Russian army in prisons as medics face sexual violence, threats and coercion upon arrival at the front. New testimonies from former female prisoners show that commanders ignore their complaints and force women to continue serving after being injured or giving birth.

data.title: Kapavka či syfilis jako suvenýr z festivalu. Nákaz pohlavní nemocí strmě přibývá
data.description: Nákazy pohlavně přenosnými nemocemi jsou v Česku rekordní. Na nejvyšší hodnoty se dostaly zejména kapavka a syfilis. Nejrozšířenější jsou dlouhodobě mezi muži majícími sex s muži. V posledních pěti letech se ale rychle šíří i v heterosexuální populaci.
data.translatedTitle: Gonorrhea or syphilis as a festival souvenir. The spread of sexually transmitted diseases is increasing sharply
data.translatedDescription: Infections with sexually transmitted diseases are at a record high in the Czech Republic. Gonorrhea and syphilis in particular reached the highest values. They are most common in the long term among men who have sex with men. In the last five years, however, it has spread rapidly even in the heterosexual population.

data.title: „Stálo to jen tisícovku“ aneb jak poznat finanční nevěru
data.description: Finanční nevěra začíná často úplně nevinně. Tajným účtem, zatajenou kreditkou nebo nákupem, o kterém partnerovi neřekneme. Peníze jsou jedním z nejčastějších zdrojů partnerských konfliktů. Mnohdy ale nejde o to, kolik utrácíme. Jde spíše o to, proč máme potřebu to před druhým tajit.
data.translatedTitle: "It only cost a thousand" or how to recognize financial infidelity
data.translatedDescription: Financial infidelity often begins quite innocently. With a secret account, a hidden credit or a purchase that we don't tell our partner about. Money is one of the most common sources of partner conflicts. But often it's not about how much we spend. It's more about why we need to hide it from others.

data.title: Éra extrémně levných asijských komponentů končí, solární panely zdražují
data.description: Po období výrazného zlevňování prochází trh s fotovoltaikou v Evropě cenovým obratem. Zatímco v předchozích letech ceny klesly na historická minima kvůli přebytkům, od počátku roku velkoobchodní ceny solárních modulů stoupají. Na českém trhu se zvýšily zhruba o 31 procent. Důvodem je především změna exportní politiky Číny, která od dubna zrušila devítiprocentní podporu exportu fotovoltaických technologií.
data.translatedTitle: The era of extremely cheap Asian components is ending, solar panels are becoming more expensive
data.translatedDescription: After a period of significant discounting, the photovoltaic market in Europe is undergoing a price reversal. While in previous years prices fell to historic lows due to oversupply, wholesale solar module prices have been rising since the start of the year. On the Czech market, they increased by roughly 31 percent. The reason is primarily the change in China's export policy, which canceled the nine percent export support for photovoltaic technologies from April.

data.title: MND investuje do akumulace. V Hodoníně zprovozňuje další bateriové úložiště
data.description: Společnost MND, člen skupiny KKCG, pokračuje v rozvoji velkokapacitních bateriových úložišť. Po letošním spuštění největšího zařízení svého druhu v Česku v Břeclavi uvádí v pondělí do testovacího provozu další projekt v Hodoníně, potvrzuje společnost v tiskové zprávě.
data.translatedTitle: MND invests in accumulation. Another battery storage facility is being put into operation in Hodonín
data.translatedDescription: MND, a member of the KKCG Group, continues to develop large-capacity battery storage. After this year's launch of the largest facility of its kind in the Czech Republic in Břeclav, another project in Hodonín is being put into test operation on Monday, the company confirms in a press release.

data.title: Při požárech na řeckém ostrově Salamina zemřel starší pár, další se evakuují
data.description: Při dvou požárech, které v neděli vypukly na řeckém ostrově Salamina nedaleko Atén, zahynuli dva lidé. Oběti jsou podle tamních médií starší manželský pár. Řecká pobřežní stráž evakuovala více než 570 místních obyvatel a turistů. Mluvčí hasičů uvedl, že jeden z požárů se podařilo uhasit, u druhého stále hoří několik ojedinělých ohnisek.
data.translatedTitle: An elderly couple died in the fires on the Greek island of Salamina, others are being evacuated
data.translatedDescription: Two people died in two fires that broke out on the Greek island of Salamina near Athens on Sunday. According to local media, the victims are an elderly married couple. The Greek Coast Guard evacuated more than 570 local residents and tourists. A spokesman for the fire department said that one of the fires was extinguished, while several isolated spots are still burning in the other.

data.title: Na severovýchodě Španělska zahynul voják, který pomáhal s hašením požáru
data.description: Při hašení rozsáhlého lesního požáru v Aragonii na severovýchodě Španělska v neděli zemřel voják. S plameny hasiči bojují už od pondělí. Přiblížily se až ke klášternímu komplexu San Juan de la Peňa, který patří k symbolům Aragonie.
data.translatedTitle: In northeastern Spain, a soldier was killed while helping to put out a fire
data.translatedDescription: A soldier died Sunday while fighting a large forest fire in Aragon, northeastern Spain. Firefighters have been fighting the flames since Monday. They approached the monastery complex of San Juan de la Peňa, which is one of the symbols of Aragon.

data.title: My jsme také lidé. Stovky migrantů v Ceutě na protestu požadovaly azyl
data.description: Bílé vlajky nebo dva prsty zdvižené do tvaru „V“ ve znamení míru. Takové a další symboly používaly v neděli při protestu stovky migrantů, kteří nedávno ilegálně pronikli do španělské exklávy Ceuta na severu Afriky. Na španělské úřady tito lidé naléhali, aby jim udělily azyl a neposílaly je zpět do Maroka.
data.translatedTitle: We are human too. Hundreds of migrants demanded asylum in a protest in Ceuta
data.translatedDescription: White flags or two fingers raised in a "V" shape for peace. Such and other symbols were used during the protest on Sunday by hundreds of migrants who recently illegally entered the Spanish exclave of Ceuta in North Africa. These people urged the Spanish authorities to grant them asylum and not to send them back to Morocco.

data.title: Nejhorší pro vystoupení jsou jižní Čechy, divná je Plzeň. Krhut o Ostravě i Stingovi
data.description: Že ho baví bavit lidi a jde mu to, si uvědomil docela pozdě. Dlouho se živil jako učitel angličtiny. Dnes vyráží komik a hudebník Jiří Krhut z rodné Ostravy po celé republice. Kromě večera u táboráku se Štěpánem Kozubem má i vlastní projekty. V humorných scénkách si posluchače rád dobírá, ale činí tak laskavě. Tedy většinou.
data.translatedTitle: South Bohemia is the worst for performances, Pilsen is weird. Krhut about Ostrava and Sting
data.translatedDescription: He realized quite late that he enjoys entertaining people and is good at it. He made a living as an English teacher for a long time. Today, comedian and musician Jiří Krhut from his native Ostrava is traveling throughout the country. In addition to an evening by the campfire with Štěpán Kozub, he also has his own projects. In humorous skits, he likes to pick on the audience, but he does so kindly. I mean, mostly.

data.title: Rekordní sucho v létě 1947 se od letošního lišilo. A komunisté katastrofy využili
data.description: Ve filmových týdenících a na fotografiích z léta 1947 můžete vidět prázdná koryta řek a potoků, vyschlé studny, vyprahlá pole, lesní požáry a lidi zmožené horkem. Podobně jako letos. Současná situace je ale díky mnoha faktorům lepší než před osmi desetiletími.
data.translatedTitle: The record drought in the summer of 1947 was different from this year. And the communists took advantage of the disaster
data.translatedDescription: In newsreels and photos from the summer of 1947, you can see empty riverbeds and streams, dry wells, parched fields, forest fires, and people exhausted by the heat. Similar to this year. But the current situation is better than eight decades ago thanks to many factors.

data.title: Manipulativní strategie a rozpory s vedením. Filozofickou fakultou otřásají spory
data.description: Filozofická fakulta Univerzity Karlovy plánuje od ledna kvůli nedostatku financí rozsáhlou reorganizaci. Ta bude provázena slučováním jednotlivých oborů a propouštěním pedagogů. Studenti i vyučující však upozorňují na rozpory v komunikaci s vedením fakulty, které považují za zarážející a manipulativní. Obavy vyjadřují také ohledně hladkého průběhu státních závěrečných zkoušek. Vedení fakulty jejich pochybnosti mírní.
data.translatedTitle: Manipulative strategies and conflicts with management. Controversy shakes the Faculty of Arts
data.translatedDescription: The Faculty of Arts of Charles University is planning an extensive reorganization starting in January due to a lack of funds. This will be accompanied by the merging of individual fields and the dismissal of pedagogues. However, both students and teachers draw attention to the contradictions in communication with the faculty management, which they consider shocking and manipulative. They also express concerns about the smooth progress of state final exams. The management of the faculty eases their doubts.

data.title: Kolik peněz stojí rodiče školák? Polovinu více než loni, výbava vyjde na tisíce
data.description: Nákup vybavení do školy se i letos podepíše na peněženkách rodičů školáků. Každá druhá česká rodina počítá, že za pomůcky do školy letos utratí více než v předchozím roce. Rodiče nejčastěji předpokládají, že je začátek školního roku jen na cvičebním úboru, přezůvkách a psacích a výtvarných potřebách do školy vyjde na tři tisíce korun.
data.translatedTitle: How much money does a schoolboy's parents cost? Half more than last year, the equipment will cost thousands
data.translatedDescription: The purchase of equipment for school will also be signed on the wallets of parents of schoolchildren this year. Every second Czech family expects to spend more on school supplies this year than in the previous year. Parents most often assume that the beginning of the school year will cost three thousand crowns just for exercise clothes, slippers and writing and art supplies.

data.title: Po násilném útoku v Českých Budějovicích zemřela žena. Podezřelého policie zadržela
data.description: Žena v Českých Budějovicích v neděli odpoledne zemřela po násilném útoku. Policisté během několika minut zadrželi podezřelého muže. Podle policie už nikomu dalšímu nebezpečí nehrozí.
data.translatedTitle: A woman died after a violent attack in České Budějovice. The suspect was detained by the police
data.translatedDescription: A woman in České Budějovice died on Sunday afternoon after a violent attack. The police apprehended the male suspect within minutes. According to the police, no one else is in danger.

data.title: Vysoké teploty i silné bouřky. Meteorologové upřesnili, na co se připravit
data.description: Meteorologové zveřejnili v neděli dopoledne novou výstrahu. Na území Moravy a Slezska varují před přetrvávající zátěží způsobenou vysokými teplotami a možným rizikem vzniku požárů. Nově však přidávají i varování před silnými bouřkami na jihovýchodě republiky.
data.translatedTitle: High temperatures and strong storms. Meteorologists specified what to prepare for
data.translatedDescription: Meteorologists published a new warning on Sunday morning. In the territory of Moravia and Silesia, they warn of persistent stress caused by high temperatures and the possible risk of fires. However, they have also added a warning against strong storms in the south-east of the country.

data.title: OBRAZEM: Pohlazení, které léčí. Beránek i hedvábnička vrací seniorům radost
data.description: Jak ulehčit život starým a nemocným lidem? Eva Bukričová za nimi jezdí se zvířaty ze svého statku a nechává je, aby se s nimi pomazlili, pohladili je, nakrmili. Nevěřili byste, jak taková zooterapie pomáhá. To, že kontakt se zvířaty je důležitý, vidí v mnoha podobách. Například jedna paní se kvůli akci nechala ostříhat u kadeřníka a jiná si pořídila bačkory s kočičím motivem.
data.translatedTitle: IMAGE: A caress that heals. Both the lamb and the silken bring joy back to the elderly
data.translatedDescription: How to make life easier for old and sick people? Eva Bukričová visits them with the animals from her farm and lets them pet them, pet them, and feed them. You wouldn't believe how such zootherapy helps. He sees that contact with animals is important in many ways. For example, one lady had her hair cut by a hairdresser for the event, and another bought a cat-themed mules.

data.title: Před sto padesáti lety obeplul moravský hrabě na fregatě svět. Na moři také válčil
data.description: Před sto padesáti lety, v létě 1876, se zámek Lysice nedaleko Blanska mimořádně otevřel návštěvníkům. Hrabě Erwin Dubský se vrátil z cesty kolem světa a chtěl všem ukázat, co se ukrývalo v šedesáti bednách, které si ze své pouti přivezl. Ve třech zámeckých sálech, jež byly otevřeny každý den dopoledne, vystavil třináct set předmětů, dneska by se možná řeklo suvenýrů, z Číny, Japonska, Kalifornie, Bombaje či Patagonie. Řadu z nich mohou příchozí na zámku obdivovat dodnes.
data.translatedTitle: One hundred and fifty years ago, a Moravian count sailed around the world on a frigate. He also fought at sea
data.translatedDescription: One hundred and fifty years ago, in the summer of 1876, the castle of Lysice, near Blansko, was exceptionally opened to visitors. Count Erwin Dubský returned from a trip around the world and wanted to show everyone what was hidden in the sixty boxes he brought back from his pilgrimage. In the three halls of the castle, which were opened every morning, he exhibited thirteen hundred objects, today one might say souvenirs, from China, Japan, California, Bombay or Patagonia. Visitors to the castle can admire a number of them to this day.

data.title: Rusové zaútočili na Kyjev balistickými raketami, Ukrajina vyslala stovky dronů
data.description: Ruské síly v neděli brzy ráno zaútočily na Kyjev balistickými raketami. V několika částech ukrajinské metropole vypukly požáry a nejméně tři lidé byli zraněni. Jeden člověk pak zemřel a třináct lidí utrpělo zranění při útoku na Kryvyj Rih. Celkem čtyři mrtvé hlásí také úřady v Doněcké, Chersonské a Záporožské oblasti. Ukrajina v noci podnikla jeden z dosud největších vzdušných útoků na Rusko.
data.translatedTitle: The Russians attacked Kiev with ballistic missiles, Ukraine sent hundreds of drones
data.translatedDescription: Russian forces attacked Kiev with ballistic missiles early Sunday morning. Fires broke out in several parts of the Ukrainian capital and at least three people were injured. One person died and thirteen people were injured in the attack on Kryvyi Rih. Authorities in the Donetsk, Kherson and Zaporozhye regions also report a total of four deaths. Ukraine carried out one of the largest aerial attacks on Russia at night.

data.title: Putin objíždí Rusko. Slábne mu podpora, FSB z něj může udělat svou loutku
data.description: Prezident Vladimir Putin v posledních týdnech vyrazil do ruských regionů, aby byl lidem více na očích před zářijovými volbami . Jeho popularita klesla na nejnižší úroveň od začátku bojů na Ukrajině, zatímco konflikt stále citelněji zasahuje do života běžných Rusů.
data.translatedTitle: Putin is touring Russia. His support is weakening, the FSB can make him their puppet
data.translatedDescription: In recent weeks, President Vladimir Putin has gone to the Russian regions to be more in the public eye before the September elections. His popularity has fallen to its lowest level since the start of the fighting in Ukraine, while the conflict is increasingly affecting the lives of ordinary Russians.

data.title: VIDEA TÝDNE: Langmajerův „rozvod“, panika v Chorvatsku a dávkoví podvodníci
data.description: Abnormálně horký týden pomalu končí, pojďte se zchladit u nejsledovanějších videí uplynulých sedmi dní. Nejvíce vás zaujaly záběry, ve kterých si Jiří Langmajer (60) a Adéla Gondíková (52) vystřelili z bulvárního časopisu, který informoval o údajném rozpadu jejich manželství. Svůj soukromý život okomentovali v humorné scénce.
data.translatedTitle: VIDEOS OF THE WEEK: Langmajer's "divorce", panic in Croatia and benefit fraudsters
data.translatedDescription: The abnormally hot week is slowly coming to an end, come and cool off with the most viewed videos of the past seven days. You were most interested in the shots in which Jiří Langmajer (60) and Adéla Gondíková (52) took shots from a tabloid magazine that reported on the alleged breakup of their marriage. They commented on their private life in a humorous skit.

data.title: Bolest je jen chvilková! Při slavném závodu Ironman v Hradci se Labe jen vařilo
data.description: Je jen jeden víkend v roce, kdy to v královéhradeckém centru takhle žije. Obrovské pozdvižení opět způsobil závod série Ironman. Největší triatlonový svátek v historii České republiky se každý rok daří ještě posouvat. Světové triatlonové hvězdy při 3. ročníku Ironman 70.3 Hradec Králové sledovaly tisícové davy.
data.translatedTitle: The pain is only momentary! During the famous Ironman race in Hradec, the Elbe was boiling
data.translatedDescription: There is only one weekend in the year when life is like this in the center of Králové-Hradec. The Ironman series race once again caused a huge stir. The biggest triathlon holiday in the history of the Czech Republic manages to move forward every year. World triathlon stars were watched by crowds of thousands at the 3rd Ironman 70.3 Hradec Králové.

data.title: Zestátnění ČEZ je špatná myšlenka, nevíme proč, kritizují exministři Stanjura i Pilný
data.description: Zestátnění energetické společnosti ČEZ a následné vytěsnění jejích minoritních akcionářů není dobrá myšlenka. Shodli se na tom v diskusním pořadu Poledne s Moravcem bývalý ministr financí Zbyněk Stanjura a bývalý ministr financí za hnutí ANO Ivan Pilný.
data.translatedTitle: The nationalization of ČEZ is a bad idea, we don't know why, ex-ministers Stanjur and Pilný criticize
data.translatedDescription: The nationalization of the energy company ČEZ and the subsequent displacement of its minority shareholders is not a good idea. Former Minister of Finance Zbyněk Stanjura and former Minister of Finance for the ANO movement Ivan Pilný agreed on this in the discussion program Poledne s Moravec.

data.title: V Maďarsku havaroval polský turistický autobus, zemřelo 12 lidí
data.description: Dvanáct lidí přišlo o život a dalších nejméně deset utrpělo zranění při noční nehodě polského autobusu na dálnici v Maďarsku. V neděli to oznámil předseda maďarské vlády Péter Magyar. Policie předpokládá, že nehodu způsobil řidič, který usnul za volantem. Podle úřadů vezl autobus polské občany z pouti v bosenském Medjugorje.
data.translatedTitle: A Polish tourist bus crashed in Hungary, 12 people died
data.translatedDescription: Twelve people lost their lives and at least ten others were injured in a night accident involving a Polish bus on a highway in Hungary. Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar announced this on Sunday. Police believe the accident was caused by a driver who fell asleep at the wheel. According to the authorities, the bus was carrying Polish citizens from a pilgrimage in Bosnia's Medjugorje.

data.title: Bradáčová chce revoluci „pasťáků“. Jen poté lze snížit trestní odpovědnost, říká
data.description: Případné snížení věkové hranice trestní odpovědnosti pod současných 15 let musí jít podle nejvyšší státní zástupkyně Lenky Bradáčové ruku v ruce se změnou výchovných ústavů, jejichž současný systém není funkční. Podle ní je také třeba chránit děti, které ve výchovných ústavech pobývají například kvůli úmrtí rodičů nebo proto, že se o ně nikdo nechce starat.
data.translatedTitle: Bradáčová wants a revolution of "shepherds". Only then can criminal liability be reduced, he says
data.translatedDescription: According to Chief State Attorney Lenka Bradáčová, a possible reduction of the age limit of criminal responsibility below the current 15 years must go hand in hand with a change in educational institutions, whose current system is not functional. According to her, it is also necessary to protect children who stay in educational institutions, for example, because of the death of their parents or because no one wants to take care of them.

data.title: Nejvíc se naučíme dialogem, říká oceněná učitelka. Vede děti ke kritickému myšlení
data.description: Celý den je obklopená hudbou, ale přímo v jejích hodinách tóny neznějí. Jana Růžičková vyučuje na brněnské konzervatoři dějiny umění. Přesto si ani při její výuce hlasivky studentů neodpočinou. Často mluví více než kantorka. Letos se umístila v desítce nejinspirativnějších učitelů Česka v soutěži Global Teacher Prize.
data.translatedTitle: We learn the most through dialogue, says the award-winning teacher. Leads children to critical thinking
data.translatedDescription: She is surrounded by music all day, but the notes are not played directly in her lessons. Jana Růžičková teaches art history at the Brno Conservatory. Nevertheless, even during her teaching, the students' vocal cords do not rest. She often talks more than the cantor. This year, she was ranked among the ten most inspiring teachers in the Czech Republic in the Global Teacher Prize competition.

data.title: Požár v Belgii už spálil skoro 3 000 hektarů, pomohou i vrtulníky z Česka
data.description: V Belgii třetím dnem bojují s jedním z nejhorších lesních požárů ve své historii, živel v těžko přístupné přírodní rezervaci na východě země už spálil téměř 3000 hektarů. Belgie spoléhá na letecké posily z několika zemí, včetně Česka, které v sobotu přislíbila Evropská unie.
data.translatedTitle: The fire in Belgium has already burned almost 3,000 hectares, helicopters from the Czech Republic will also help
data.translatedDescription: In Belgium, for the third day, they are fighting one of the worst forest fires in their history, the element in a difficult-to-access nature reserve in the east of the country has already burned almost 3,000 hectares. Belgium relies on air reinforcements from several countries, including the Czech Republic, which was promised by the European Union on Saturday.

data.title: Za tři dny ukradli v Hradci Králové devět Toyot. Zloději auta odvážejí do Polska
data.description: Na pozoru by se měli mít majitelé osobních automobilů značky Toyota RAV 4. Policisté v Hradci Králové evidují za poslední tři dny již devět krádeží těchto vozů, které podle nich pachatelé převážejí na území sousedního Polska. Vyšetřovatelé pracují s verzí, že má jejich odcizení na svědomí organizovaná skupina.
data.translatedTitle: In three days, they stole nine Toyotas in Hradec Králové. Thieves take cars to Poland
data.translatedDescription: Owners of Toyota RAV 4 cars should be on the lookout. The police in Hradec Králové have registered nine thefts of these cars in the last three days, which they believe the perpetrators are transporting to the territory of neighboring Poland. Investigators are working with the version that an organized group is responsible for their abduction.

data.title: Klimatická krize skončila, tvrdí Ševčík. Motoristé se vysmívají, řekla poslankyně
data.description: Zvládne vláda Andreje Babiše boj se suchem? Podle poslance SPD Miroslava Ševčíka si současná vláda počíná velmi dobře. Ocenil také kroky Motoristů na ministerstvu životního prostředí, kteří omezili financování některých klimatických projektů. „Některé rádoby zelené programy přírodě naopak škodí,“ uvedl. Proti jeho slovům se ohradila poslankyně STAN Pavla Pivoňka Vaňková.
data.translatedTitle: The climate crisis is over, claims Ševčík. Motorists are laughing, said the deputy
data.translatedDescription: Will the government of Andrej Babiš manage to fight the drought? According to SPD MP Miroslav Ševčík, the current government is doing very well. He also praised the actions of Motorists at the Ministry of the Environment, who limited the financing of some climate projects. "On the contrary, some would-be green programs harm nature," he said. STAN MP Pavla Pivoňka Vaňková objected to his words.

data.title: V Jihoafrické republice vyhnali migranty z továren. Teď v nich nemá kdo pracovat
data.description: Protesty proti migrantům v Jihoafrické republice měly pomoci místním získat více pracovních míst. V textilním Newcastlu se ale dostavil opačný efekt. Po odchodu stovek zahraničních zaměstnanců mají tamní továrny problém najít náhradu a stroje zůstávají nevyužité.
data.translatedTitle: Migrants were kicked out of factories in South Africa. There is no one to work in them now
data.translatedDescription: Anti-migrant protests in South Africa were supposed to help locals get more jobs. But the opposite effect occurred in textile Newcastle. After the departure of hundreds of foreign workers, factories there are having trouble finding replacements, and machines remain unused.

data.title: Rekordszámú filmmel érkezik a 33. Országos/Kárpát-medencei Diákfilmszemle
data.description: Minden vetítési napot nyilvános szakmai konzultáció zár.
data.translatedTitle: The 33rd National/Carpathian Basin Student Film Review arrives with a record number of films
data.translatedDescription: Each screening day ends with a public professional consultation.

data.title: A mór mehet
data.description: A tápláléklánc végén ott a nagy filantróp, az emberiség jótevője.
data.translatedTitle: The Moor can go
data.translatedDescription: At the end of the food chain there is the great philanthropist, the benefactor of humanity.

data.title: Élmény lesz a tanulás
data.description: A Facebook-kormány oszlopos tagja most sem a közoktatást nyomasztó kérdésekkel foglalkozik, hanem megkésett kampányvideót gyártott elődei lejáratására.
data.translatedTitle: Learning will be an experience

data.title: Bird flu kills 13,000 seal pups on remote Australian island
data.description:
SYDNEY: A pathogenic strain of bird flu killed more than 13,000 elephant seal pups after infecting a breeding colony on a sub-Antarctic volcanic island, Australian scientists said Thursday.
	Researchers found the remote Heard and McDonald Islands littered with seal carcasses when they arrived on a research expedition in October 2025.
	Genetic testing confirmed the contagious H5 bird flu strain had killed seals, penguins and birds living on the rocky outcrop — the first time it had been detected in one of Australia’s external territories.

data.title: Australia says net migration down as far-right popularity surges
data.description:
SYDNEY: Australia’s immigration levels fell last year, official data showed on Thursday, as its center-left government seeks to combat an ascendent far-right riding a wave of public discontent over soaring housing prices and cost of living.
	Net overseas migration added 301,000 people to Australia’s population of 28 million last year, Canberra’s Bureau of Statistics reported.
	Immigration minister Tony Burke said the figure was down nine percent from a year earlier and 45 percent lower than a post-Covid peak in 2023.

data.title: Oil falls to 3-1/2-month low after US, Iran sign ceasefire deal
data.description:
BEIJING/SINGAPORE: Oil prices ​fell by more than $2 per barrel on Thursday after the US and Iran signed an interim agreement that ‌would end the Iran war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and waive US sanctions on Tehran’s oil, boosting the oil supply outlook.

	Brent crude futures were down $2.14, or 2.69 percent, at $77.41 a barrel as of 09:16 a.m. Saudi time, and US West Texas Intermediate fell $2.36, or 3.07 percent, to $74.43 a barrel.

data.title: Daily Telegraph columnist argues Saudi Arabia should join G7
data.description:
DUBAI: Saudi Arabia should be invited to join the Group of Seven nations as the organization adapts to a changing global order, according to a column published in the Daily Telegraph by former UK prime ministerial representative to Saudi Arabia Ken Costa.

	Costa argued that while the G7 was created in the aftermath of the 1970s oil crisis, the world has changed dramatically since then, with new economic and geopolitical powers emerging. Despite those shifts, he said the group remains largely unchanged and no longer reflects the realities of global influence.

data.title: Rubaya : environ 100 familles sans abri après la démolition de leurs habitations pour l’extension du carré minier
data.description: Près d’une centaine de familles se retrouvent sans abri après la démolition de leurs maisons dans le centre minier de Rubaya, situé dans le territoire de Masisi, au Nord-Kivu. Selon des sources locales, cette opération, entamée il y a environ une semaine, s’est poursuivie samedi 15 aout 2026 dans un secteur communément appelé « Chez Rutivumbura », à la périphérie de la cité.
data.translatedTitle: Rubaya: around 100 families left homeless after the demolition of their homes for the extension of the mining area
data.translatedDescription: Nearly a hundred families find themselves homeless after the demolition of their homes in the mining center of Rubaya, located in the Masisi territory, North Kivu. data.title: « L’interdiction des vols commerciaux crée des difficultés économiques à Bunia », alerte un notable de l’Ituri
data.description: L’interdiction des vols commerciaux à l’aéroport de Bunia, dans le cadre des mesures de lutte contre Ebola, continue de susciter des réactions en Ituri. Ils demandent aux autorités d’assouplir cette restriction.
data.translatedTitle: “The ban on commercial flights creates economic difficulties in Bunia,” warns a notable from Ituri

While humanitarian flights remain authorized, some residents denounce a measure which, according to them, further penalizes a population already faced with insecurity and the consequences of the epidemic. They ask the authorities to relax this restriction.

data.title: Tras 90 años de su muerte, aún no se encuentran los restos de Lorca ¿Por qué?
data.description: Este 18 de agosto se cumplen 90 años de su asesinato. Se cree que fue fusilado en un paraje entre los pueblos de Víznar y Alfacar, en la provincia de Granada, en el sur de España. El régimen de Franco (1939-1975) prohibió hablar de este asesinato, y la figura y obra de Lorca sufrieron una fuerte censura durante décadas. The post Tras 90 años de su muerte, aún no se encuentran los restos de Lorca ¿Por qué? first appeared on Cubadebate .
data.translatedTitle: After 90 years of his death, Lorca's remains have still not been found. Why?
data.translatedDescription: This August 18 marks 90 years since his murder. It is believed that he was shot in an area between the towns of Víznar and Alfacar, in the province of Granada, in southern Spain. The Franco regime (1939-1975) prohibited talking about this murder, and Lorca's figure and work suffered strong censorship for decades. The post After 90 years of his death, Lorca's remains have not yet been found. Why? first appeared on Cubadebate.

data.title: Tabla de posiciones tras triunfo de Olimpia vs Motagua; hay nuevo líder
data.description: ¡Nuevo líder! La jornada 3 del torneo Apertura 2026 llegó a su fin y este domingo fueron tres los duelos programados: Choloma vs Marathón , Olimpia vs Motagua y el derbi en el cierre de esta noche entre Olancho vs Juticalpa. Tras esos primeros dos duelos, hay movimientos en la tabla de posiciones y nuevo mandamás en lo que va del certamen tras el tropiezo del Real España ante Independiente (1-1) el sábado por la noche en el Morazán. Las acciones de este domingo comenzaron con el agónico triunfo del Marathón sobre el CD Choloma (0-1) en el Estadio Rubén Deras. Jonathan Moya le dio los tres puntos a los verdolagas para escalar puestos en la tabla. Más adelante, el Olimpia firmó un contundente triunfo en el superclásico ante Motagua. Los Albos comenzaron cayendo tras un error de Menjívar, pero se repusieron para una remontada 3-1 en el Nacional y, con este resultado, tomaron el liderato del torneo Apertura 2026. Por último, el Olancho FC logró vencer por la mínima al Juticalpa en el derbi. Con esto, los Potros escalaron varios puestos para ubicarse en la pelea de la clasificación del torneo. Tras la jornada 3, el Olimpia se baja al Real España de la cima. Los leones llevan paso perfecto en el inicio de la temporada y ahora comandan con 9 puntos. Por su parte, los Aurinegros pasan a la segunda plaza con 7 unidades. El tercer lugar lo ocupa el Marathón , que este domingo escaló luego de sumar su segundo triunfo. El Monstruo verde acumula también 7 puntos al igual que el Olancho FC , cuarto con la misma cantidad; en el quinto puesto le sigue el Génesis FC con 6. Estrella Roja e Independiente de Siguatepeque continúan en la lista con 4. Motagua es octavo con 3, Lobos UPNFM noveno con 2, Platense es penúltimo con 1 punto y en el fondo se ubica el Juticalpa FC con cero unidades.
data.translatedTitle: Table of positions after victory of Olimpia vs Motagua; there is a new leader
data.translatedDescription: New leader! Day 3 of the Apertura 2026 tournament came to an end and this Sunday there were three scheduled duels: Choloma vs Marathón, Olimpia vs Motagua and the derby at the close tonight between Olancho vs Juticalpa. After those first two duels, there are movements in the standings and a new boss so far in the competition after Real España's setback against Independiente (1-1) on Saturday night at the Morazán. This Sunday's actions began with the agonizing victory of Marathón over CD Choloma (0-1) at the Rubén Deras Stadium. Jonathan Moya gave the Purslanes three points to climb positions in the table. Later, Olimpia achieved a resounding victory in the superclásico against Motagua. Los Albos began by falling after an error by Menjívar, but recovered for a 3-1 comeback at Nacional and, with this result, took the lead in the Apertura 2026 tournament. Finally, Olancho FC managed to narrowly beat Juticalpa in the derby. With this, the Colts climbed several places to be in the fight for the tournament classification. After matchday 3, Olimpia drops to Real España at the top. The lions have been on a perfect pace at the start of the season and now lead with 9 points. For their part, the Aurinegros move to second place with 7 units. Third place is occupied by Marathón, which climbed this Sunday after adding its second victory. The Green Monster also accumulates 7 points like Olancho FC, fourth with the same amount; In fifth place is followed by Génesis FC with 6. Estrella Roja and Independiente de Siguatepeque continue on the list with 4. Motagua is eighth with 3, Lobos UPNFM ninth with 2, Platense is second to last with 1 point and at the bottom is Juticalpa FC with zero units.

data.title: Edrick Menjívar y el peor error en su carrera: Insólito gol en el Olimpia - Motagua
data.description: El portero Edrick Menjívar cometió un terrible error en el inicio del clásico del fútbol hondureño entre Olimpia y Motagua, correspondiente a la tercera jornada del Torneo Apertura 2026 de la Liga Nacional de Honduras. Apenas habían transcurrido tres minutos desde el pitazo inicial cuando el guardameta del conjunto olimpista protagonizó uno de los errores más llamativos que se le recuerden durante su exitosa carrera. La jugada comenzó cuando el lateral izquierdo de Motagua, Clever Portillo, ganó la línea de fondo y sacó un centro al área. El envío tomó completamente por sorpresa a Menjívar, quien se encontraba mal ubicado y no pudo reaccionar a tiempo ante la trayectoria del balón. De manera increíble, la pelota terminó en el fondo de las redes ante la mirada del propio guardameta, provocando la euforia de los jugadores y aficionados de Motagua, que celebraron el inesperado tanto desde los primeros minutos del clásico. Menjívar no pudo contener el esférico y quedó señalado en una acción que rápidamente se convirtió en uno de los momentos más comentados. Cabe recordar que el guardameta de Olimpia también fue noticia durante la semana, luego de que trascendiera un fuerte interés del Saprissa de Costa Rica, club que estaría siguiendo sus pasos de cara a la próxima temporada.
data.translatedTitle: Edrick Menjívar and the worst mistake in his career: Unusual goal at Olimpia - Motagua
data.translatedDescription: Goalkeeper Edrick Menjívar made a terrible mistake at the start of the Honduran soccer classic between Olimpia and Motagua, corresponding to the third day of the 2026 Apertura Tournament of the Honduran National League. Barely three minutes had passed since the initial whistle when the goalkeeper of the Olympic team made one of the most striking errors that can be remembered during his successful career. The play began when Motagua's left back, Clever Portillo, gained the baseline and took a cross into the area. The delivery took Menjívar completely by surprise, who was in a bad position and could not react in time to the trajectory of the ball. Incredibly, the ball ended up in the back of the net before the goalkeeper himself, causing euphoria among the Motagua players and fans, who celebrated the unexpected goal from the first minutes of the classic. Menjívar could not contain the ball and was singled out in an action that quickly became one of the most talked about moments. It is worth remembering that the Olimpia goalkeeper was also in the news during the week, after strong interest emerged from Saprissa of Costa Rica, a club that would be following in his footsteps for the next season.

data.title: Pareja desaparecida es encontrada calcinada en Tambla, Lempira
data.description: Levis Arelis Pascual Núñez, de 31 años, y Anayeli Raquel Gómez Fuentes, de 17, una pareja reportada como desaparecida desde el viernes 14 de agosto, fueron localizadas sin vida en Tambla, Lempira , donde presuntamente fueron encontrados restos calcinados . Ambas personas son originarias del municipio de Tómala, Lempira , y habían sido reportadas como desaparecidas desde el pasado viernes. Desde entonces, familiares y pobladores mantenían la búsqueda para conocer su paradero. El supuesto hallazgo de los restos generó consternación entre habitantes de Tambla, debido a las circunstancias en las que habrían sido encontrados. De manera preliminar, se presume que los restos localizados podrían corresponder a los dos jóvenes desaparecidos. Sin embargo, esta información todavía requiere ser confirmada oficialmente por las autoridades. La identidad de los restos deberá establecerse mediante los procedimientos correspondientes de Medicina Forense, mientras los investigadores trabajan para reconstruir lo ocurrido. Hasta ahora tampoco se conocen las circunstancias en las que la pareja habría perdido la vida ni quiénes podrían estar involucrados en el hecho. El caso permanece bajo investigación y se espera que las autoridades brinden información oficial sobre el hallazgo, la identificación de los restos y las circunstancias de la muerte de la pareja.
data.translatedTitle: Missing couple found burned in Tambla, Lempira
data.translatedDescription: Levis Arelis Pascual Núñez, 31, and Anayeli Raquel Gómez Fuentes, 17, a couple reported missing since Friday, August 14, were found dead in Tambla, Lempira, where charred remains were allegedly found. Both people are originally from the municipality of Tómala, Lempira, and had been reported missing since last Friday. Since then, relatives and residents have been searching to find out his whereabouts. The alleged discovery of the remains generated consternation among residents of Tambla, due to the circumstances in which they were found. Preliminarily, it is presumed that the remains located could correspond to the two missing young people. However, this information still needs to be officially confirmed by the authorities. The identity of the remains must be established through the corresponding Forensic Medicine procedures, while investigators work to reconstruct what happened. Until now, the circumstances in which the couple would have lost their lives or who could be involved in the event are not known. The case remains under investigation and authorities are expected to provide official information about the discovery, the identification of the remains and the circumstances of the couple's death.

data.title: Onda tropical dejará lluvias en Honduras, pero persiste déficit de agua
data.description: Las lluvias que dejará una onda tropical este lunes y martes en Honduras serán insuficientes para aliviar la sequía que afecta varias regiones del país, aunque permitirán algunos aportes de agua a los embalses, informó Francisco Argeñal, director de Cenaos. “Tenemos pronóstico de lluvias para mañana debido al ingreso de una onda tropical . Se van a generar precipitaciones en la mayor parte del país”, pronosticó el especialista. Las precipitaciones alcanzarán diferentes sectores, entre ellos las zonas sur y central, así como el norte de Tegucigalpa. En los alrededores de la capital se prevén acumulados de entre 10 y 15 milímetros. “En la zona occidental esperamos acumulados de 20 a 30 milímetros y máximos de hasta 50 milímetros, principalmente en las partes altas de Ocotepeque”, detalló Argeñal. Las lluvias serán principalmente chubascos de leves a moderados y de corta duración. Algunos episodios podrían extenderse aproximadamente durante media hora. “Después tendremos condiciones secas prácticamente hasta finales de la próxima semana. Los remanentes podrían generar algunos chubascos aislados el martes”, informó el entrevistado. Aunque las precipitaciones permitirán que el agua comience a correr sobre el suelo y generarán algún aporte a los embalses, el beneficio será mínimo frente al déficit acumulado. “Con acumulados de 5 a 10 milímetros el agua ya corre sobre el suelo, pero será un aporte mínimo. No significa que se vaya a resolver el problema”, consideró Argeñal. El director de Cenaos señaló que la canícula intensa continuará hasta finales de agosto o principios de septiembre. Posteriormente, se espera una recuperación de las precipitaciones durante septiembre y octubre. La sequía también mantiene bajo análisis los niveles de las principales fuentes de abastecimiento de las represas La Concepción y Los Laureles , además de la hidroeléctrica Francisco Morazán, conocida como El Cajón . “Esta situación tiene un fuerte impacto en La Concepción y Los Laureles, y también en El Cajón , porque el río Humuya está recibiendo poca agua”, informó Argeñal. Ante este escenario, el Sistema Nacional de Emergencias (SINAE) analizará este lunes la situación de las alertas junto con representantes técnicos de Copeco. La evaluación incluirá los resultados del trabajo de campo realizado en 74 municipios, donde se midieron los efectos de la sequía en seguridad alimentaria, producción agrícola, agua para consumo humano y salud.
data.translatedTitle: Tropical wave will leave rain in Honduras, but water deficit persists
data.translatedDescription: The rains that a tropical wave will leave this Monday and Tuesday in Honduras will be insufficient to alleviate the drought that affects several regions of the country, although they will allow some contributions of water to the reservoirs, reported Francisco Argeñal, director of Cenaos. "We have a rain forecast for tomorrow due to the entry of a tropical wave. Rainfall will be generated in most of the country," the specialist predicted. The rainfall will reach different sectors, including the southern and central areas, as well as the north of Tegucigalpa. In the surroundings of the capital, accumulations of between 10 and 15 millimeters are expected. “In the western area we expect accumulations of 20 to 30 millimeters and maximums of up to 50 millimeters, mainly in the high parts of Ocotepeque,” ​​Argeñal explained. The rains will be mainly light to moderate showers of short duration. Some episodes could last approximately half an hour. "Then we will have dry conditions practically until the end of next week. The remnants could generate some isolated showers on Tuesday," reported the interviewee. Although the rainfall will allow water to begin running over the ground and will generate some contribution to the reservoirs, the benefit will be minimal compared to the accumulated deficit. "With an accumulation of 5 to 10 millimeters, the water is already running over the ground, but it will be a minimal contribution. It does not mean that the problem will be solved," Argeñal considered. The director of Cenaos pointed out that the intense heatwave will continue until the end of August or beginning of September. Subsequently, a recovery in rainfall is expected during September and October. The drought also keeps the levels of the main supply sources of the La Concepción and Los Laureles dams under analysis, in addition to the Francisco Morazán hydroelectric plant, known as El Cajón. “This situation has a strong impact on La Concepción and Los Laureles, and also in El Cajón, because the Humuya River is receiving little water,” Argeñal reported. Given this scenario, the National Emergency System (SINAE) will analyze the situation of the alerts this Monday together with technical representatives of Copeco. The evaluation will include the results of field work carried out in 74 municipalities, where the effects of the drought on food security, agricultural production, water for human consumption and health were measured.

data.title: Video del momento en que sicario se acerca y dispara a abogada en un bar
data.description: Un video captó el momento en que un sicario se acercó hasta la abogada Helenn Giuliana Silva Padilla , dentro de un restaurante-bar de Pacasmayo, Perú, y le disparó una vez en la cabeza . El ataque fue directo y la mujer murió en el lugar. En las imágenes se observa a Silva Padilla dentro del establecimiento cuando el sicario se aproxima hasta donde se encuentra. El atacante lleva un arma de fuego y se dirige directamente hacia la víctima. Luego, el sicario saca el arma, apunta a la cabeza de la abogada y dispara a corta distancia. Tras recibir el impacto, Silva Padilla cae al suelo y queda inmóvil. El agresor abandona rápidamente el lugar después de cometer el ataque. Las imágenes forman parte de los elementos que podrían ser analizados por las autoridades para intentar esclarecer el asesinato. El crimen ocurrió en el centro poblado San Martín de Porres, distrito de San José, provincia de Pacasmayo. El hecho causó consternación entre los pobladores y activó las investigaciones para identificar al responsable. Silva Padilla había asumido la defensa de Junior Alexander Acosta Tuñoque, un joven que sufrió la amputación de su pierna izquierda tras un incidente ocurrido el 30 de mayo de 2024. La abogada había cuestionado el archivo de una investigación contra tres efectivos policiales relacionados con ese caso y anunciado que presentaría un recurso de queja para intentar revertir la decisión fiscal. Ahora, las autoridades investigan el asesinato de la profesional y deberán determinar quién ordenó y ejecutó el ataque, así como establecer el móvil del crimen.
data.translatedTitle: Video of the moment when a hitman approaches and shoots a lawyer in a bar
data.translatedDescription: A video captured the moment when a hitman approached lawyer Helenn Giuliana Silva Padilla, inside a restaurant-bar in Pacasmayo, Peru, and shot her once in the head. The attack was direct and the woman died at the scene. In the images, Silva Padilla is seen inside the establishment when the hitman approaches where he is. The attacker carries a firearm and is heading directly towards the victim. Then, the hitman takes out the gun, points it at the lawyer's head and shoots at close range. After receiving the impact, Silva Padilla falls to the ground and remains motionless. The aggressor quickly leaves the scene after committing the attack. The images are part of the elements that could be analyzed by the authorities to try to clarify the murder. The crime occurred in the town of San Martín de Porres, district of San José, province of Pacasmayo. The incident caused consternation among residents and activated investigations to identify the person responsible. Silva Padilla had assumed the defense of Junior Alexander Acosta Tuñoque, a young man who suffered the amputation of his left leg after an incident that occurred on May 30, 2024. The lawyer had questioned the filing of an investigation against three police officers related to that case and announced that she would file a complaint to try to reverse the prosecutor's decision. Now, the authorities are investigating the murder of the professional and must determine who ordered and carried out the attack, as well as establish the motive for the crime.

data.title: Hondureños en Estados Unidos todavía tienen opciones ante el final definitivo del TPS
data.description: El Departamento de Seguridad Nacional de Estados Unidos (DHS) volvió a advertir que la terminación del Estatus de Protección Temporal (TPS) ya está vigente para ciudadanos de países cuya protección fue cancelada y lanzó un mensaje directo a quienes no cuentan con otra autorización para permanecer en territorio estadounidense: deben salir del país o enfrentar una eventual deportación. Para los hondureños, el escenario implica que el TPS dejó de ser por sí solo una protección contra la deportación y una base para mantener autorización de empleo. El Servicio de Ciudadanía e Inmigración de Estados Unidos (USCIS) mantiene a Honduras entre los países cuya designación y beneficios asociados fueron terminados, luego de una larga disputa judicial alrededor de la decisión adoptada por el Gobierno estadounidense. El TPS fue concedido originalmente a Honduras después de la devastación provocada por el huracán Mitch y permitió durante más de dos décadas que miles de hondureños permanecieran y trabajaran legalmente en Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, el DHS determinó en 2025 que las condiciones que dieron origen a la designación ya no justificaban mantenerla. La terminación del programa no significa que todos los hondureños anteriormente protegidos por TPS sean deportados automáticamente . La situación dependerá del caso migratorio particular de cada persona. Quienes tengan residencia permanente, una solicitud de asilo, un proceso familiar, una petición migratoria u otra autorización independiente del TPS deberán regirse por las condiciones de ese trámite. Para quienes dependían exclusivamente del TPS, el panorama es diferente: deben determinar si tienen otra vía legal para permanecer en Estados Unidos o prepararse para salir del país . USCIS mantiene información específica sobre Honduras y recomienda verificar individualmente cualquier otro beneficio migratorio para el cual la persona pueda ser elegible. Lily Maldonado, experta en temas de inmigración de de Lily Maldonado Immigration Services, explicó a LA PRENSA que la cancelación del TPS no significa que todos los hondureños beneficiarios tengan que salir inmediatamente de Estados Unidos. Señala que muchas personas podrían contar con otras alternativas migratorias, por lo que recomienda analizar cada caso de manera individual antes de asumir que la única salida es regresar a Honduras. Maldonado indica que entre los tepesianos puede haber personas que entraron legalmente a Estados Unidos, salieron del país y posteriormente volvieron a ingresar con una autorización, una circunstancia que podría abrir posibilidades para realizar un ajuste de estatus, dependiendo de las condiciones particulares de cada persona. También menciona que quienes tengan familiares que puedan presentar una petición migratoria deben revisar si cumplen los requisitos para iniciar ese proceso. La especialista pone especial atención en los hondureños que tienen hijos ciudadanos estadounidenses mayores de 21 años, pues estos podrían, bajo determinadas condiciones, presentar una petición a favor de sus padres. Asimismo, advierte que existen otras circunstancias personales que podrían permitir avanzar hacia algún beneficio migratorio, pero insiste en que no existe una solución única aplicable a todos los antiguos beneficiarios del TPS. También explica que algunas personas que ya tenían un proceso migratorio en marcha pudieron haber obtenido avances o contar con antecedentes que ahora deben ser revisados. Por ello, recomienda acudir a un abogado de inmigración para determinar qué opciones continúan disponibles una vez cancelado el TPS.“Cada caso es diferente”, recalca Maldonado al pedir a los afectados que no tomen decisiones precipitadas. Su recomendación es buscar asesoría legal calificada para establecer si existe alguna alternativa que les permita permanecer legalmente en Estados Unidos antes de considerar un eventual retorno a Honduras. Ante esta situación, la Cancillería hondureña elaboró una Guía para hondureños bajo TPS en Estados Unidos, actualizada durante 2026, con información dirigida a las personas afectadas por los cambios en el programa. La documentación oficial plantea que pueden existir alternativas migratorias dependiendo de factores como los vínculos familiares, el tiempo de permanencia en Estados Unidos y las circunstancias particulares de cada beneficiario. La orientación del Gobierno hondureño recomienda que cada tepesiano revise su caso con asesoría migratoria calificada antes de tomar una decisión, pues haber tenido TPS durante años no crea automáticamente un derecho a residencia permanente, pero tampoco impide que una persona pueda reunir los requisitos de otro mecanismo migratorio. La guía también forma parte de las acciones emprendidas por Honduras para preparar a sus ciudadanos frente a un eventual retorno. La Cancillería ha mantenido información a través de su red consular y ha insistido en que los hondureños consulten fuentes oficiales para evitar información falsa o servicios migratorios fraudulentos. El mensaje más reciente de las autoridades estadounidenses endurece nuevamente el escenario para quienes ya no cuentan con TPS y tampoco poseen otra autorización de permanencia. Para miles de familias hondureñas que construyeron su vida durante décadas en Estados Unidos, la pregunta ya no es únicamente cuándo terminaría el programa, sino qué alternativa migratoria tienen para quedarse legalmente o cómo enfrentar un posible retorno a Honduras.
data.translatedTitle: Hondurans in the United States still have options before the definitive end of TPS
data.translatedDescription: The United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS) once again warned that the termination of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) is now in effect for citizens of countries whose protection was canceled and sent a direct message to those who do not have other authorization to remain in the United States: they must leave the country or face eventual deportation. For Hondurans, the scenario implies that TPS alone ceased to be a protection against deportation and a basis for maintaining employment authorization. The United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) maintains Honduras among the countries whose designation and associated benefits were terminated, after a long judicial dispute surrounding the decision adopted by the US Government. TPS was originally granted to Honduras after the devastation caused by Hurricane Mitch and allowed thousands of Hondurans to stay and work legally in the United States for more than two decades. However, DHS determined in 2025 that the conditions that gave rise to the designation no longer justified maintaining it. The termination of the program does not mean that all Hondurans previously protected by TPS will be automatically deported. The situation will depend on the particular immigration case of each person. Those who have permanent residence, an asylum application, a family process, an immigration petition or other authorization independent of the TPS must be governed by the conditions of that process. For those who depended exclusively on TPS, the outlook is different: they must determine if they have another legal means to remain in the United States or prepare to leave the country. USCIS maintains specific information about Honduras and recommends individually verifying any other immigration benefits for which the person may be eligible. Lily Maldonado, immigration expert at Lily Maldonado Immigration Services, explained to LA PRENSA that the cancellation of TPS does not mean that all Honduran beneficiaries have to immediately leave the United States. He points out that many people could have other immigration alternatives, so he recommends analyzing each case individually before assuming that the only way out is to return to Honduras. Maldonado indicates that among the Tepesians there may be people who entered the United States legally, left the country and subsequently re-entered with authorization, a circumstance that could open possibilities for adjusting status, depending on the particular conditions of each person. It also mentions that those who have family members who can present an immigration petition should check if they meet the requirements to start that process. The specialist pays special attention to Hondurans who have US citizen children over 21 years of age, since they could, under certain conditions, present a petition on behalf of their parents. Likewise, he warns that there are other personal circumstances that could allow progress toward some immigration benefit, but insists that there is no single solution applicable to all former TPS beneficiaries. It also explains that some people who already had an immigration process underway may have made progress or have background information that now needs to be reviewed. For this reason, he recommends going to an immigration lawyer to determine what options remain available once TPS is canceled. “Each case is different,” Maldonado emphasizes when asking those affected not to make hasty decisions. Their recommendation is to seek qualified legal advice to establish if there is any alternative that allows them to remain legally in the United States before considering an eventual return to Honduras. Given this situation, the Honduran Foreign Ministry prepared a Guide for Hondurans under TPS in the United States, updated during 2026, with information aimed at people affected by the changes in the program. Official documentation states that there may be immigration alternatives depending on factors such as family ties, length of stay in the United States and the particular circumstances of each beneficiary. The Honduran Government's guidance recommends that each Tepesian review their case with qualified immigration advice before making a decision, since having had TPS for years does not automatically create a right to permanent residence, but neither does it prevent a person from meeting the requirements of another immigration mechanism. The guide is also part of the actions undertaken by Honduras to prepare its citizens for an eventual return. The Foreign Ministry has maintained information through its consular network and has insisted that Hondurans consult official sources to avoid false information or fraudulent immigration services. The most recent message from the US authorities once again toughens the scenario for those who no longer have TPS and do not have another authorization to remain. For thousands of Honduran families who built their lives for decades in the United States, the question is no longer only when the program would end, but what immigration alternative they have to stay legally or how to face a possible return to Honduras.

data.title: Asesinan a pareja de jóvenes tras salir de una pulpería en Victoria, Yoro
data.description: Una pareja de jóvenes fue asesinada a balazos por desconocidos en el sector de Bajo Grande, comunidad de San Juan, en Victoria, Yoro, según confirmaron las autoridades este domingo. Las víctimas fueron identificadas como Dilmer Murillo Romero y su pareja, Yaneli Castro Guerrero , quien era madre de dos menores. De acuerdo con los reportes preliminares, ambos regresaban a su vivienda después de realizar compras en una pulpería de la zona. Durante el trayecto, la pareja habría sido interceptada por desconocidos que, sin mediar palabra, l es dispararon en repetidas ocasiones. El ataque armado dejó a ambos jóvenes sin vida en el lugar. Hasta ahora, las autoridades no han informado sobre las circunstancias que habrían provocado el crimen. Agentes policiales realizan las primeras diligencias para tratar de establecer quiénes participaron en el ataque y determinar el móvil del doble homicidio. Hasta el momento, no se reportan personas detenidas por este caso. Las investigaciones continúan para identificar a los responsables. Los cuerpos de Dilmer Murillo Romero y Yaneli Castro Guerrero fueron trasladados a la morgue sampedrana, donde se realizarán los procedimientos legales correspondientes antes de ser entregados a sus familiares.
data.translatedTitle: A young couple is murdered after leaving a grocery store in Victoria, Yoro
data.translatedDescription: A young couple was shot to death by unknown persons in the Bajo Grande sector, community of San Juan, in Victoria, Yoro, as confirmed by the authorities this Sunday. The victims were identified as Dilmer Murillo Romero and his partner, Yaneli Castro Guerrero, who was the mother of two minors. According to preliminary reports, both were returning to their home after shopping at a grocery store in the area. During the journey, the couple was allegedly intercepted by unknown individuals who, without saying a word, shot them repeatedly. The armed attack left both young people dead at the scene. Until now, authorities have not reported on the circumstances that led to the crime. Police agents are carrying out the first steps to try to establish who participated in the attack and determine the motive for the double homicide. So far, no people have been arrested in this case. Investigations continue to identify those responsible. The bodies of Dilmer Murillo Romero and Yaneli Castro Guerrero were transferred to the Sampedrana morgue, where the corresponding legal procedures will be carried out before being handed over to their relatives.
