data.title: Selección de Grandes Crímenes: El amor también mata
data.description: LINA. Se llamaba Rosalina. No era muy alta, pero era hermosa, con una cara bonita, en la que brillaban dos ojos color miel grandes, llenos de vida y de sueños; su piel era blanca, llevaba el pelo pintado de oro y sonreía siempre, a pesar de que llevaba algunas penas en el corazón... hasta que, un día, esas penas terminaron para siempre. Apareció muerta en su propia cama. El forense dijo que tenía, al menos, unas cinco horas de haber muerto. Sus ojos estaban vidriosos, fijos en el techo, la boca entreabierta y la cabeza tirada un poco hacia atrás sobre la almohada, como si le hubiera faltado el aire y deseara tragarlo a bocanadas. Su esposo, con el que se había casado hacía apenas un año, no quiso despertarla a las cuatro de la mañana. Se levantó despacio, se bañó, y se fue a la cocina a hacerle el desayuno. Siempre comían juntos en la mañana antes de ir al trabajo. Marcela, la hija de Lina ya estaba lista para ir al colegio. Se graduaba ese año, y estudiaría Medicina. Era alta, bonita, elegante y de piel más blanca que la de su madre. Y tenía aquella sonrisa dulce que, seguramente, había heredado de ella. Sin embargo, esa mañana estaba rara... “Tu mamá va a salir del cuarto -le dijo Luis-, hablamos después. Quiero que esto se termine”. Marcela se sentó, le puso miel a sus panqueques y sorbió un poco de jugo. “Ya terminó” -dijo, cortando un pedazo con el tenedor.Luis no le hizo caso. Estaba de espaldas a ella en la cocina. Marcela, agregó: “Eso se llama matar el tigre y tenerle miedo al cuero”. Luis se volvió.“Mejor andá a llamar a tu mamá. Los panqueques están calientes”. “No va a venir” -dijo la muchacha. “No te entiendo”.“Eso no va a venir”. Se levantó, se acercó a Luis y lo besó en la boca, con esa pasión adolescente que llega a ser como volcanes en erupción. “Podemos hacerlo aquí” -le dijo la muchacha. “¿Estás loca?” -rechinó él, separándose un poco. “Sí, estoy loca... Ya te lo dije... Desde que los vi... Desde que...” “¿Podés callarte? Esto no puede seguir”. “Seguirá -replicó ella, con voz melosa-, seguirá. Recordá que vos me hiciste mujer, y yo no quiero ver a otro hombre. Mi virginidad fue tuya, y yo soy tuya... Y más ahora”. “¿Qué querés decir?” “Lo que parece que no has visto bien... Andá al cuarto”. Luis temblaba de pies a cabeza y sudaba helado. Hablaba despacio, repitiendo las palabras como si no estuviera seguro de que fueran claras. A veces se agarraba la cabeza con las manos, apretaba los dientes y se tragaba sus lágrimas. Sus dos hijos, ya mayores, estaban con él, y dos abogados lo asistían, mientras el fiscal del Ministerio Público hacía una pregunta tras otra. “Repítame, por favor -le dijo-, el momento en que usted fue al cuarto”. Luis esperó un poco, miró a sus abogados y estos le hicieron señal de que hablara. “Fui -balbuceó-. Algo me asustó en la voz de Marcela. Se notaba tan segura, tan rara, y tan osada en la cocina, tanto, que se había quitado el uniforme y se me insinuaba”. Aquí se mordió la lengua. “Yo tenía miedo de que Lina saliera del cuarto de un momento a otro... Sabía que yo estaba haciendo el desayuno y ella comía antes de bañarse para ir al trabajo...” “Siga”. “Entré... Estaba la luz apagada, lo que me pareció extraño. La encendí, y me acerqué a ella... La vi...” Tembló de nuevo. “Grité... La llamé... La toqué... Estaba helada... Marcela venía detrás de mí. Venía desnuda y me dijo: ‘Vos me dijiste que si ella no estuviera serías muy feliz conmigo... Y ya no está’. Yo le grité: ‘¿Qué fue lo que hiciste?’ Ella me dijo: ‘Lo que teníamos que hacer’. Se me acercó; no sé cómo me tumbó en la cama... Yo no sabía dónde estaba”. El comisario sorbió un poco del café que ya se había enfriado en su taza, dio vuelta a dos páginas del expediente y me dijo: “Recibimos órdenes de que no se mencionara nada de este caso; ni siquiera a los periodistas. Don Luis es... Don Luis... Ya me entiende usted. Era mayor que su esposa, Lina. Ella tenía treinta y tres; él, cincuenta y ocho; ella fue madre adolescente, se enamoró a los quince y tuvo a su hija a los dieciséis. Él era divorciado, tenía dos hijos de treinta y de treinta y dos años. Dijo que era feliz con Lina, pero que, poco a poco, se fue fijando en su hijastra, que es alta, muy hermosa, bonita y sensual. ¡Y cínica, por supuesto! Una criminal despiadada”. “¿La entrevistaron?” “¡Es menor de edad! -exclamó el comisario-. Ya sabe usted, Carmilla, lo que eso significa... fiscal de la niñez, derechos de la niñez, abogados, psicólogos, trabajadores sociales, jueces maniatados, policías amarrados, abogados defensores que son perros de garra...” “¿Abogados defensores?” “Sí... ¡Tres! Una mujer, una abogada famosa; dos varones con colmillos y dos asesores... ¡Pagados por don Luis! ”“¿Qué?” “Ya ve como son las cosas”. El comisario bebió su café casi de un solo trago. Señaló una foto y después otra. La primera era la de un hombre mayor, atractivo, de pelo gris y blanco en las sienes, ojos claros, de porte elegante y señorial; la segunda era Marcela, sonriente, bonita, posando como para una revista. Era la fotografía que le tomaron en la escena del crimen. “Lina estaba desnuda en la cama -siguió diciendo el policía-; su esposo dijo que había tenido intimidad con ella la noche anterior... Y dijo algo más. Cuando ella se durmió fue a la cocina a traer agua. Marcela lo estaba esperando furiosa y le dijo: Te vi, los vi otra vez. Y no lo soporto”. “Callate que vas a despertar a tu mamá -le dijo don Luis-. ¿Qué querés que haga? Es mi esposa”. Ella le reclamó: “¿Y yo? ¿Qué soy yo para vos?” “Marcela...” La agarró de una mano y la llevó a su cuarto. “Mañana hablamos... No te alterés más... Calmate”. “Ella no entendía razones -siguió diciendo el comisario-; lo tendió en la cama... Don Luis prometió que lo diría todo y que estaba dispuesto a asumir las consecuencias de sus actos y de sus malas decisiones...” “Tuvo intimidad con una menor de edad”. “Ese era su delito”. “Tenía que pagar”. El comisario suspiró. “Carmilla -dijo, mientras nos servían el desayuno-, ya sabe usted qué poderoso caballero es don dinero”. Puso abundante chile sobre los huevos estrellados. “Además, Marcela declaró que estaba con él por su propia voluntad, y que nunca la obligó a nada; que, más bien, ella fue la que lo sedujo... Y dio más explicaciones que están aquí en el expediente, pero no sé si puede presentárselas a sus lectores”. “Veamos”. Lina estaba muerta. Don Luis habló con la Policía sin esconder nada; Marcela no fue ese día al colegio. La llevaron a la Policía. Sus abogados dijeron que no sabía lo que decía, y que no era responsable de sus declaraciones. Y agregaron que policías y fiscales no eran autoridad competente. Que Marcela declararía ante el juez. ¿Cómo murió Lina? ¿Por qué tenía que morir? ¿Quién le quitó la vida? ¿Cómo? ¿En qué momento? ¿Por qué? ¿Qué pasó con don Luis? ¿Y Marcela? “Solo le pido que no dé muchos detalles -me dijo el comisario de policía-; no quiero problemas, pero este caso es...” “¿Espeluznante?” “Y de película”. Yo no respondí. “Esta es una copia del expediente” -dijo el policía, entregándome una carpeta con varias hojas impresas adentro. Había borrado con marcador negro los nombres CONTINUARÁ LA PRÓXIMA SEMANA
data.translatedTitle: Selection of Great Crimes: Love also kills
data.translatedDescription: LINA. Her name was Rosalina. She was not very tall, but she was beautiful, with a pretty face, in which two large honey-colored eyes shone, full of life and dreams; His skin was white, his hair was painted gold and he always smiled, even though he carried some sorrows in his heart... until, one day, those sorrows ended forever. She was found dead in her own bed. The coroner said he had been dead for at least five hours. His eyes were glassy, ​​fixed on the ceiling, his mouth half open and his head thrown back a little on the pillow, as if he had been out of breath and wanted to gulp it down. Her husband, whom she had married just a year ago, did not want to wake her up at four in the morning. He got up slowly, took a bath, and went to the kitchen to make her breakfast. They always ate together in the morning before going to work. Marcela, Lina's daughter was ready to go to school. He was graduating that year, and would study Medicine. She was tall, pretty, elegant and had whiter skin than her mother. And he had that sweet smile that, surely, he had inherited from her. However, that morning she was strange... "Your mother is going to leave the room," Luis told him, "we'll talk later. I want this to be over." Marcela sat down, put honey on her pancakes and sipped some juice. “It's over,” he said, cutting a piece with the fork. Luis ignored him. He had his back to her in the kitchen. Marcela added: “That is called killing the tiger and being afraid of the leather.” Luis turned around. “You better go call your mom. The pancakes are hot.” “He's not coming,” said the girl. “I don't understand you.” “That's not going to happen.” He got up, approached Luis and kissed him on the mouth, with that adolescent passion that becomes like erupting volcanoes. “We can do it here,” the girl told him. “Are you crazy?” -he grated, separating himself a little. "Yes, I'm crazy... I already told you... Since I saw them... Since..." "Can you shut up? This can't go on." "It will continue," she replied, with a honeyed voice, "it will continue. Remember that you made me a woman, and I do not want to see another man. My virginity was yours, and I am yours... And even more so now." “What do you mean?” “What it seems like you haven't seen well... Go to the room.” Luis was shaking from head to toe and was sweating cold. He spoke slowly, repeating the words as if he wasn't sure they were clear. Sometimes he clutched his head with his hands, clenched his teeth and swallowed his tears. His two children, now grown, were with him, and two lawyers assisted him, while the prosecutor from the Public Ministry asked one question after another. “Repeat to me, please,” he said, “the moment you went to the room.” Luis waited a little, looked at his lawyers and they signaled for him to speak. "I went," she stammered. "Something scared me in Marcela's voice. She seemed so confident, so strange, and so daring in the kitchen, so much so that she had taken off her uniform and was making advances toward me." Here he bit his tongue. “I was afraid that Lina would leave the room at any moment… She knew that I was making breakfast and she was eating before taking a shower to go to work…” “Go on.” "I went in... The light was off, which seemed strange to me. I turned it on, and I approached her... I saw her..." He trembled again. "I screamed... I called her... I touched her... She was frozen... Marcela was coming after me. She came naked and told me: 'You told me that if she wasn't there you would be very happy with me... And she's not there anymore.' I shouted at her: 'What did you do?' She told me: 'What we had to do.' The commissioner sipped some of the coffee that had already cooled in his cup, turned two pages of the file and told me: "We received orders that nothing about this case be mentioned, not even to journalists. Don Luis is... Don Luis... You understand what I mean. He was older than his wife, Lina. She was thirty-three; he was fifty-eight; she was a teenage mother, fell in love at fifteen and had her daughter at sixteen. He was divorced, he had two children. "Thirty and thirty-two years old. He said he was happy with Lina, but little by little he began to notice his stepdaughter, who is tall, very beautiful, pretty and sensual, and of course a ruthless criminal." “Did they interview her?” "She's a minor! -exclaimed the commissioner-. You already know, Carmilla, what that means... children's prosecutor, children's rights, lawyers, psychologists, social workers, tied up judges, tied up police officers, defense lawyers who are claw dogs..." "Defense lawyers?" "Yes... Three! A woman, a famous lawyer; two men with fangs and two advisors... Paid by Don Luis! ""What?" “You see how things are.” The commissioner drank his coffee almost in one gulp. He pointed to one photo and then another. The first was that of an older, attractive man, with gray hair and white at the temples, light eyes, and an elegant and stately bearing; The second was Marcela, smiling, pretty, posing as if for a magazine. It was the photograph taken at the crime scene. "Lina was naked in bed," the police officer continued, "; her husband said he had been intimate with her the night before... And he said something else. When she fell asleep he went to the kitchen to get water. Marcela was waiting for him furiously and told him: I saw you, I saw them again. And I can't stand it." "Shut up, you're going to wake up your mother," Don Luis told him. "What do you want me to do? She's my wife." She demanded: "And me? What am I to you?" “Marcela…” He grabbed her hand and took her to her room. "We'll talk tomorrow... Don't get upset anymore... Calm down." "She didn't understand reasons," the commissioner continued, "she laid him on the bed... Don Luis promised that he would tell everything and that he was willing to assume the consequences of his actions and bad decisions..." "He had intimacy with a minor." “That was his crime.” “I had to pay.” The commissioner sighed. “Carmilla,” he said, while they served us breakfast, “you know what a powerful gentleman Mr. Money is.” He put plenty of chili on the fried eggs. "In addition, Marcela declared that she was with him of her own free will, and that he never forced her to do anything; that, rather, she was the one who seduced him... And she gave more explanations that are here in the file, but I don't know if she can present them to her readers." “Let's see.” Lina was dead. Don Luis spoke with the Police without hiding anything; Marcela did not go to school that day. They took her to the police. His lawyers said he did not know what he was saying, and that he was not responsible for his statements. And they added that police and prosecutors were not competent authorities. That Marcela would testify before the judge. How did Lina die? Why did he have to die? Who took his life? As? At what time? Because? What happened to Don Luis? And Marcela? “I only ask that you not give too many details,” the police commissioner told me, “I don't want problems, but this case is…” “Creepy?” “And from a movie.” I didn't respond. “This is a copy of the file,” said the police officer, handing me a folder with several printed pages inside. I had erased the names with black marker. TO BE CONTINUED NEXT WEEK

data.title: Tegucigalpa pierde 40 de cada 100 litros de agua por tuberías dañadas en plena crisis
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- La crisis hídrica que enfrenta Tegucigalpa no solo está marcada por los bajos niveles de las represas . El sistema de distribución también pierde cerca del 40% del agua que ingresa. Gustavo Boquín, gerente de la Unidad Municipal de Agua Potable y Saneamiento (UMAPS), explicó que el sistema de la capital fue diseñado alrededor de tres fuentes principales: las represas Los Laureles y La Concepción, además de la fuente superficial de El Picacho. Ese esquema fue concebido para abastecer a una ciudad de aproximadamente un millón de habitantes y con sectores distribuidos según cada fuente. "Nuestro diseño de sistema tiene tres fuentes, dos represadas y una a filo de agua que es El Picacho. Eso se diseñó para darle agua a un millón de personas", explicó. De acuerdo con Boquín, originalmente Los Laureles abastecía principalmente el sector del aeropuerto, La Concepción cubría la zona de la Kennedy y sectores aledaños, mientras El Picacho atendía el norte de la ciudad. Ahora, debido a la escasez, ese diseño tuvo que modificarse: "Hoy, por necesidad, interconectamos la ciudad y repartimos agua de todos lados. Los Laureles, por ejemplo, ahorita le da agua a la Kennedy, porque hay que mandar el agua hacia allá", detalló. Esta alta demanda, con el pasar de los años, ha colapsado las tuberías y ahora representa una gran pérdida para los capitalinos, ya quetermina desperdiciandose. Boquín explicó que: "Estamos botando el 40% de agua que entra al sistema. Por cada 100 litros que envío al sistema, solo le llegan al capitalino 60; 40 se pierden en el camino". Esto significa que, mientras la ciudad enfrenta una emergencia por la reducción del agua disponible en las represas, una parte importante del recurso que sí logra ingresar al sistema termina perdiéndose antes de llegar a los hogares. Mientras esperan mejores lluvias, las autoridades también buscan aumentar la disponibilidad mediante nuevas fuentes subterráneas. Julio Quiñónez, coordinador de Programa de Adaptacion Urbana al cambio climático informó que el pozo ubicado en los predios de la antigua Penitenciaría Central ya está en proceso de aforo y análisis de calidad antes de incorporarlo al sistema. Además, fueron habilitados dos pozos previamente perforados: el de Almendros y el del Hospital Mario Mendoza. "Esto contribuye para poder inyectar agua al sistema. El de la PC todavía le hace falta un poco", detalló. Por ahora, la recuperación de los embalses continúa dependiendo del comportamiento de las lluvias, mientras la UMAPS intenta ganar tiempo mediante una distribución más espaciada, el uso de pozos y el traslado de agua entre las distintas fuentes que abastecen a Tegucigalpa y Comayagüela.
data.translatedTitle: Tegucigalpa loses 40 out of every 100 liters of water due to damaged pipes in the midst of the crisis
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The water crisis facing Tegucigalpa is not only marked by the low levels of the dams. The distribution system also loses about 40% of the water that enters it. Gustavo Boquín, manager of the Municipal Drinking Water and Sanitation Unit (UMAPS), explained that the capital's system was designed around three main sources: the Los Laureles and La Concepción dams, in addition to the surface source of El Picacho. This scheme was conceived to supply a city of approximately one million inhabitants and with sectors distributed according to each source. "Our system design has three sources, two dammed and one running along the river, which is El Picacho. That was designed to give water to one million people," he explained. According to Boquín, originally Los Laureles mainly supplied the airport sector, La Concepción covered the Kennedy area and surrounding sectors, while El Picacho served the north of the city. Now, due to the shortage, that design had to be modified: "Today, out of necessity, we interconnect the city and distribute water from all sides. Los Laureles, for example, right now gives water to Kennedy, because we have to send the water there," he explained. This high demand, over the years, has collapsed the pipes and now represents a great loss for the residents of the capital, since it ends up being wasted. Boquín explained that: "We are throwing away 40% of the water that enters the system. For every 100 liters that I send to the system, only 60 reach the capital; 40 are lost along the way." This means that, while the city faces an emergency due to the reduction of water available in the dams, an important part of the resource that does manage to enter the system ends up being lost before reaching homes. While they wait for better rains, authorities are also looking to increase availability through new underground sources. Julio Quiñónez, coordinator of the Urban Adaptation Program to climate change, reported that the well located on the grounds of the former Central Penitentiary is already in the process of capacity and quality analysis before incorporating it into the system. In addition, two previously drilled wells were enabled: that of Almendros and that of the Mario Mendoza Hospital. "This helps to be able to inject water into the system. The PC system still needs a little bit," he explained. For now, the recovery of the reservoirs continues depending on the behavior of the rains, while the UMAPS tries to gain time through more spaced distribution, the use of wells and the transfer of water between the different sources that supply Tegucigalpa and Comayagüela.

data.title: Tudeng märkas looma kivistises midagi kummalist – nüüd peab imetajate ajaloo ümber kirjutama
data.description: Uus uuring pakub esmakordselt kivististe põhjal tõendeid, et imetajasarnased roomajad ehk künodondid tõid ilmale elusaid järglasi. Ligi 236 miljonit aastat tagasi elanud Chiniquodon theotonicus’e luukoe analüüs näitas, et looma poegade ja täiskasvanu kehamassi suhe sarnanes tänapäevaste imetajate omaga, nihutades sünnitamise evolutsioonilise alguse kuni 95 miljoni aasta võrra varasemaks.
data.translatedTitle: The student noticed something strange in the fossil of the animal - now the history of mammals must be rewritten
data.translatedDescription: A new study provides the first fossil evidence that mammal-like reptiles, or cynodonts, gave birth to living offspring. An analysis of the bone tissue of Chiniquodon theotonicus, which lived nearly 236 million years ago, showed that the animal's cub-to-adult body mass ratio was similar to that of modern mammals, pushing the evolutionary beginning of childbirth up to 95 million years earlier.

Ometi usub suur osa inimestest endiselt, et ohtlikust gaasist võiks kuidagi ise aru saada – halva enesetunde, lõhna, suitsu või mõne muu märgi järgi. G4S tellitud uuring näitab, et teadmine vingugaasi nähtamatusest ei ole sugugi iseenesestmõistetav.
data.translatedTitle: WHAT ABOUT YOU? ⟩ Surprisingly, many people are unaware of one big danger at home
data.translatedDescription: Carbon monoxide is called the invisible killer for a reason: it cannot be seen, smelled or tasted. However, a large number of people still believe that they could somehow recognize a dangerous gas by themselves - by feeling unwell, smell, smoke or some other sign. Research commissioned by G4S shows that knowledge of the invisibility of carbon monoxide is by no means self-evident.

data.title: 19-aastase briti ratturi surm vallandas raevu, ratturite ühendus nõuab paremaid kiivreid
data.description: Reedel juhtus traagiline õnnetus Portugali velotuuril, kus kokkupõrkel sõidukiga kaotas elu 19-aastane briti rattur Finlay Tarling. Profijalgratturite assotsiatsioon (CPA) tegi avalduse, milles nõuab jalgratturitele turvalisemaid kiivreid.

data.translatedDescription: On Friday, a tragic accident occurred during the Portugal bike tour, where 19-year-old British rider Finlay Tarling lost his life in a collision with a vehicle. The Professional Cyclist Association (CPA) issued a statement calling for safer helmets for cyclists.

data.title: Miks tugev stressireaktsioon ei pruugi olla nõrkus, vaid hoopis keha nutikas kaitsemehhanism
data.description: Uus uuring seostab soolestiku mitmekesisemat mikrobioomi tugevama ja võimalik, et paremini kohaneva reaktsiooniga lühiajalisele stressile. Samas on see vaid üks osa vastupidavuse keerulisest puslest.
data.translatedTitle: Why a strong stress reaction may not be a weakness, but instead a smart defense mechanism of the body
data.translatedDescription: A new study links a more diverse gut microbiome to a stronger and possibly more adaptive response to short-term stress. However, this is only one part of the complex puzzle of resilience.

data.title: UURING ⟩ See igapäevane harjumus tõstab hüppeliselt eesnäärmevähi riski
data.description: Mõned igapäevased harjumused tunduvad nii tavalised, et me ei oska neis ohtu naha. Uus laiaulatuslik uuring tõi aga päevavalgele murettekitava seose: ülitöödeldud toitude regulaarne söömine suurendab oluliselt eesnäärmevähi riski.
data.translatedTitle: RESEARCH ⟩ This daily habit skyrockets the risk of prostate cancer
data.translatedDescription: Some daily habits seem so common that we don't know how to put them at risk. However, a new large-scale study has brought to light an alarming connection: regular consumption of highly processed foods significantly increases the risk of prostate cancer.

data.title: Saaremaa puuma peremees: «Minu jaoks oli üllatav, kui kõvasti ma pean teda hammustama»
data.description: Kuigi Saaremaa loomaaias elav puumatüdruk Zuma kaalub üle 30 kilogrammi, ei heiduta see peremeest sugugi ning ta käib oma lemmikut iga päev puuris kaisutamas. «Usaldan Zumat rohkem kui mõnda teist looma siin,» ütleb Risto Ränk. Eesti ainus puuma Zuma on tõeline staar, kes on võitnud nii Risto kui ka kõikide loomaaia külastajate südamed.
data.translatedTitle: Saaremaa's cougar owner: "It was surprising to me how hard I have to bite him"
data.translatedDescription: Although Zuma, the cougar girl living in the Saaremaa Zoo, weighs more than 30 kilograms, this does not deter the owner at all and she goes to cuddle her favorite in the cage every day. "I trust Zuma more than any other animal here," says Risto Ränk. Zuma, the only cougar in Estonia, is a real star who has won the hearts of both Risto and all zoo visitors.

data.title: BLOGI JA GALERII ⟩ Kergejõustiku EMi 7. päev: Amy Hunt kirjutas ajalugu, Duplantis võitis neljanda EM-tiitli
data.description: Birminghami kergejõustiku EMi viimasel võistluspäeval jagus põnevust viimase alani. Hommikupoolikul tulid rajale maratoonarid, õhtuses programmis pakkusid aga enim kõneainet meeste teivashüpe, kus Armand Duplantis püstitas võistluste rekordi, ning teatejooksud. Postimees vahendas sündmusi otseblogis.
data.translatedTitle: BLOG AND GALLERY ⟩ Day 7 of the EC Athletics Championships: Amy Hunt made history, Duplantis won her fourth EC title
data.translatedDescription: On the last competition day of the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham, there was excitement down to the last area. In the mid-morning, the marathoners came to the track, but in the evening program, the men's pole vault, where Armand Duplantis set a competition record, and the relay races were the most talked about events. Postimees mediated the events in a live blog.

data.title: GALERII ⟩ Võrafest tõi Pärnusse ainulaadse sündmuse – mida pidulised asjast arvavad?
data.description: Sel nädalavahetusel esmakordselt toimunud rahvatantsu- ja võimlemisfestival Võrafest tõi Pärnu tänavatele ja parkidesse esinemisi ja töötube, kus kohtusid pea 2500 eri põlvkondade rahvatantsijat ja võimlejat. Üritusest moel või teisel osa saanud kiitsid suvepealinna festivalipaigana maast taevani. Korraldajad seisavad aga otsuse ees, kas üritusest saab traditsioon ja Pärnust ettevõtmise kodu.
data.translatedTitle: GALLERY ⟩ Võrafest brought a unique event to Pärnu - what do the celebrants think about it?
data.translatedDescription: The folk dance and gymnastics festival Võrafest, held for the first time this weekend, brought performances and workshops to the streets and parks of Pärnu, where nearly 2,500 folk dancers and gymnasts of different generations met. Those who participated in the event in one way or another praised the summer capital as a festival location from earth to heaven. However, the organizers face a decision whether the event will become a tradition and Pärnu the home of the enterprise.

data.title: ÜLEVAADE ⟩ Venemaa «Amazonis» on müügil Kalevi šokolaad, iPhone'id ja kuulivestid. Mis on Wildberries ja miks on sellest saanud Ukraina droonide sihtmärk?
data.description: Ühest ja samast veebipoest saab tellida Kalevi šokolaadi, iPhone 17 Pro Maxi, IKEA mööbli, FPV-drooni, taktikalise kiivri ja kuulivesti. See kõlab nagu segu Amazonist, Temust ja sõjavarustuse poest, kuid tegelikult on tegemist Venemaa suurima e-kaubandusplatvormi Wildberriesega. «Kuuuurija» vaatas, mida sealt tegelikult osta saab, ning selgitab, miks on Ukraina viimastel nädalatel just selle ettevõtte logistikakeskused droonidega sihikule võtnud.
data.translatedTitle: OVERVIEW ⟩ Russian "Amazon" sells Kalev chocolate, iPhones and bulletproof vests. What are Wildberries and why has it become a target of Ukrainian drones?
data.translatedDescription: You can order Kalev chocolate, iPhone 17 Pro Max, IKEA furniture, FPV drone, tactical helmet and bulletproof vest from the same online store. It sounds like a mix of Amazon, Temu, and a military hardware store, but it's actually Wildberries, Russia's largest e-commerce platform. "Kuuuurija" looked at what can actually be bought there, and explains why in recent weeks Ukraine has targeted the logistics centers of this particular company with drones.

data.translatedTitle: PM IN PARIS ⟩ Disappointed Jefimova: Those five hundredths again, 4th place again... I need to train more mentally
data.translatedDescription: The European Championship in Paris severely tested the mental strength of Estonia's best swimmer Eneli Jefimova. He was five hundredths of a second away from a medal twice, and after the 100-meter breaststroke on Sunday, he was also awarded 4th place in half the shorter distance. Jefimova admitted that she was tired, especially mentally.

data.title: Vilnietės bandymai pasiekti Nerį baigėsi „atradimu“: prie statybvietės užtverti visi keliai
data.description: Vilnietė Rita sako mėgstanti su vaikais keliauti po sostinę. Kartais pėsčiomis, kartais dviračiais, tačiau jie teigia išmaišę visą miestą ir jo apylinkes. Ypač traukia gamtinės teritorijos. Tad vieną gražią šios vasaros dieną jie nusprendė patyrinėti Neries pakrantes netoli „Litexpo“ rūmų. Bet čia jų laukė, kaip piktinasi, „atradimas“ – dviračių takus, laiptus jie rado užtvertus dėl šalia vykstančių statybų. Vis dėlto tiek savivaldybė, tiek ir statytojai ramina, kad tai laikina.
data.translatedTitle: Attempts by a woman from Vilnius to reach Neri ended with a "discovery": all roads near the construction site were blocked
data.translatedDescription: Rita from Vilnius says she likes to travel around the capital with her children. Sometimes on foot, sometimes on bicycles, but they claim to have messed up the whole city and its surroundings. Natural areas are particularly attractive. So, one fine day this summer, they decided to explore the banks of the Neris near the Litexpo Palace. But here, as they complain, a "discovery" awaited them - they found the bicycle paths and stairs blocked due to the construction going on nearby. However, both the municipality and the builders reassure that it is temporary.

data.title: US Military YouTuber Paid His Own Way to Cover Ukraine's Front Line
data.description: Justin Taylor, a former US Army infantry officer turned YouTuber, self-funded a two-week reporting trip to Ukraine's front line. He spent nearly a week near active fighting and witnessed drone attacks nightly. He was struck by Ukraine's improvised tech – coordinating via WhatsApp and Zoom instead of encrypted military systems – yet matching costlier Western capabilities. Taylor argues continued US/NATO support remains vital, citing Cold War deterrence, and plans a return trip.

data.title: Ukraine’s Onofriichuk Wins Gold at Gymnastics World Championships
data.description: Ukrainian gymnast Taisiia Onofriichuk secured the gold medal in the hoop exercise at the Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, scoring 30.700 points. Italy’s Sofia Raffaeli took silver, and Germany’s Darja Varfolomeev won bronze. The victory marks Onofriichuk’s first career world title and Ukraine’s first World Championship gold in rhythmic gymnastics since 2013.

data.title: Russia Limits Fuel Sales After Ukrainian Drone Strikes on Refineries
data.description: Following Ukrainian drone strikes on oil refineries, Russian regions are imposing fuel sales limits. In the Orenburg region, purchases are capped at 30 liters per car after an attack on the Orsknefteorgsintez refinery. The Novosibirsk region has capped fuel retail markups at 15%. In occupied Crimea, where fuel prices spiked up to 270 rubles ($3) per liter during a brief period of open sales, authorities have implemented strict price caps and resumed a QR-code rationing system. The fuel and electricity shortages have severely impacted Crimea’s tourism industry, with hotel bookings dropping 70%.

data.title: Ukraine Disables 7 of 10 Largest Wildberries Warehouses
data.description: The Ukrainian Defense Ministry stated on Aug. 16 that it has successfully disabled seven of the ten largest logistics centers belonging to the Russian e-commerce platform Wildberries. The announcement followed drone strikes in the Moscow region that caused large fires at the company’s 250,000-square-meter (2,691,000 square-feet) Koledino complex and the Severnoye Domodedovo facility, forcing them to halt operations. The strikes are part of a sustained kinetic and cyber campaign against Wildberries, which Ukraine designates as a legitimate military target for allegedly selling dual-use goods to the Russian military. Prior to these latest attacks, analysts estimated the company had already lost up to one-third of its warehouse capacity, equating to approximately $5.7 billion in financial losses.

data.title: Lithuania Does Not Rule Out ‘False Flag’ in Latvia Drone Incident
data.description: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevičius said it cannot be ruled out that the drone shot down over Latvia on Aug. 14 was part of a “false flag” operation, though he emphasized that evidence is pending the drone’s recovery. Sinkevičius explained that experts expect to trace the drone’s origin and target using its microchips once found. The incident follows warnings from Lithuanian Defense Minister Robertas Kaunas that Russia might use captured Ukrainian drones to stage provocations against Baltic critical infrastructure, aiming to shift blame to Kyiv.

data.title: The Iran War Toll
data.description: The Iran war failed to achieve regime change or dismantle its nuclear program, instead rallying Iranians behind a more radical leadership. It drained scarce US air-defense missiles needed in Ukraine and Taiwan, pushed oil prices higher while fueling Russia's war chest, and let Iran leverage control of the Strait of Hormuz. Perhaps most damaging: allies like Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are now hedging away from Washington, accelerating a broader erosion of US alliances and dollar dominance.

data.title: Spanish F-18 Downs Unidentified Drone in Romanian Airspace
data.description: A Spanish F-18 fighter jet on combat patrol shot down an unidentified drone over Romania early Sunday morning, Aug. 16, after the object breached national airspace from Moldova. The Romanian Defense Ministry reported the drone was intercepted over an unpopulated area in Galați County. Acting Defense Minister Radu Miruță praised the allied response. The interception follows a series of recent airspace violations, including the discovery of drone fragments near the Ukrainian border and on Black Sea beaches on Aug. 14, as well as the destruction of two Russian Gerbera drones near offshore gas facilities on Aug. 11.

data.title: Over 1,550 Drones, 62 Missiles Target Ukraine in One Week
data.description: Russian forces launched over 1,550 attack drones, nearly 1,560 aerial bombs, and 62 missiles—primarily ballistic – at Ukraine over the past week, President Volodymyr Zelensky reported on Sunday, Aug. 16. Zelensky detailed recent casualty figures, noting two dead and 14 injured in Kryvyi Rih, six injured in Kyiv and the surrounding region, and one dead in Sumy. Thirteen regions were targeted in total. Zelensky urged European partners to provide air defense interceptors currently sitting in warehouses, stating they are necessary to counter the use of North Korean ballistic missiles.

data.title: Russia Unveils Jet-Powered BM-35 Drone With 217 Mph Speed
data.description: Russian propagandists released footage of an upgraded, jet-powered BM-35 attack drone. According to Ukrainian expert Serhii Beskrestnov, the Russians claim the drone can reach speeds exceeding 350 km/h (217 mph) and strike targets up to 200 kilometers (124 miles) away. The drone reportedly carries a 10-kilogram warhead and can be operated in first person view (FPV) mode, allegedly unaffected by electronic warfare.

data.title: Ukraine Tests Last Shadow T200 Interceptor Drone, Exceeding Expected Range
data.description: Ukrainian defense developer Ukrainska Bavovna has successfully tested the new “Last Shadow T200” interceptor drone, achieving a range of 122 kilometers (76 miles) during recent combat trials – well beyond the originally anticipated 70 kilometers (43 miles). The T200 is designed to defend against Russian Shahed, Geran, Gerbera, and Molniya drones, featuring a top speed of 300 km/h and an operational ceiling of 5 kilometers. The aircraft includes anti-spoofing technology to counter Russian electronic warfare systems like “Shtora” and is currently transitioning from 3D printing to cast manufacturing. Interceptor drones now account for approximately 40% of Ukraine’s successful engagements against Russian long-range attack UAVs.

data.title: Poland Proposes European Legion With Ukrainian Veterans
data.description: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski advocated for the creation of a permanent “European Legion” during an interview with Ekathimerini. Sikorski emphasized that Europe must take greater responsibility for its security rather than relying solely on the US, while maintaining that the proposed force would complement rather than compete with NATO.

data.title: Gulf Allies Question US Ties Over Iran Conflict
data.description: US allies in the Persian Gulf, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Qatar, are increasingly frustrated with US President Donald Trump’s diplomatic approach to the war with Iran. Regional officials cite unpredictable policy shifts and have begun questioning the necessity of hosting US military bases. The discontent follows a recent mutual defense pact between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, indicating a push to diversify security partnerships. Meanwhile, negotiations between Washington and Tehran remain stalled over the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, and commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains halted amid an ongoing US blockade.

data.title: Cabral abriu a mão de todo o conforto que tinha na altura (em Lisboa e em Bissau), e decidiu dar sua vida para o seu povo. Lutou para acabar não só com a miséria, mas também para dar educação ao seu povo, um sonho que felizmente brotou e hoje podemos contar com quadros qualificados. Por isso é triste e vergonhoso constatar que alguns desses ditos “quadros qualificados” são gananciosos e outros são bajuladores
data.description: António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13
data.translatedTitle: Cabral gave up all the comfort he had at the time (in Lisbon and Bissau), and decided to give his life to his people. He fought to end not only poverty, but also to provide education to his people, a dream that fortunately came to fruition and today we can count on qualified staff. That is why it is sad and shameful to see that some of these so-called “qualified cadres” are greedy and others are sycophants.

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. data.translatedTitle: DSP the Greedy Machiavellian
data.translatedDescription: Guineans, once again, I come to warn you about the danger that Domingos Simões Pereira represents for Guinea-Bissau. I issue this warning to all Guineans without exception, whether in the country or abroad, to PAIGC in particular and to Cipriano Cassamá in particular. This warns about the true DSP, the true spirit that moves this guy, which some still continue to believe in, not to say adore. Domingos Simões Pereira is a manipulator, a true blackmailer and probably calculating, a type of behavior that goes beyond the level of psychopath. A disproportionately ambitious man, a true criminal who knows how and when to commit the crime. He would never cohabit not only with JOMAV, as well as with any president who would be elected, except the one he covertly supported. This is because he has his own agenda, and PAIGC is simply a platform for its achievement. DSP would never cohabit with JOMAV because its preferred candidate was Paulo Gomes and always will be, who together with Tchitchi are outlining a mechanism to become the new owners of Guinea-Bissau. According to them, this is a medium-term process, and it takes courage and patience to achieve it. Winning the congress no matter what the circumstances and having the party in hand again, is a phase completed to their advantage, while true PAIGC activists are clapping. After this legislative election, no matter the result, Cipriano Cassama must prepare his suitcase or keep his mouth shut, as the preferred candidate for the party will be Paulo Gomes, and he must have a voice within the party. DSP is a disproportionately ambitious person, he never had any consideration for anyone, JOMAV even less so, the guy is a born Machiavellian, Cipriano Casama will be discarded when he least expects it and he can take notice. Guineans, talking about Paulo Gomes and Tchitchi is talking about MCCI and other organizations and camouflaged personalities in our country. These two individuals are the main financiers of MCCI and other well-known personalities in the city of Bissau. The MCCI, Militia created by JBV and DSP, now financed and directed by the "future triangle of power" that is, "DSP, Paulo Gomes and Tchitchi", has 3 main objectives: 1st Disrupt public order in the name of citizenship, defame and try to discredit any organizations or individuals not aligned with the triangle, in order to support their journeys in search of power. 2nd If the objective of the triangle is achieved, the role of the MCCI Militia will become constant surveillance of all adversaries in order to guarantee false social peace and the power of control. 3rd Try to gain credibility with international and regional organizations, through your visits and cover activities, so that when there are public disturbances, they can gain notoriety. But this should not worry anyone, as they are well identified and well hunted, inside and outside Guinea-Bissau. I have nothing against anyone, but whoever continues to disturb the true social peace of Guineans in exchange for benefits, as has always been the case in the last years of this crisis, and which I have always tolerated, then let it be clear "I am firm and determined for everything and everyone". To conclude, I would like to leave a reflection with the following sentence: " Domingos Simões Pereira is a serious danger for the future of the country ". This is because publishing here everything necessary to prove or support the reason for this sentence can only further worsen the social peace that we so desperately need. Enough, enough, we cannot continue to live in this turbulence our whole lives, my Guinean brothers, it is not healthy, it is toxic, it is not fair for a people who have suffered so much. data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio.
